live.title: My live lessons
live.dashboardBody: Your purchased programs, your teacher, and your next step.
live.cardBody: Meet your teachers and find the right person to guide your learning.
live.chooseBody: Find a teacher you feel comfortable with. Open their profile, get to know their approach, and explore their availability.
live.emptyTitle: Your teachers will be here soon.
live.emptyBody: Your package is ready. We’re preparing the teaching team for this program. Contact us if you need help getting started.
live.sameTeacher: One teacher for both your group and private lessons.
live.personalGuidance: A familiar face to support you throughout your program.
live.stepThree: Find a time for your lessons
live.signInBody: Sign in to access your purchased live programs and choose a teacher.
live.errorBody: Please try again. Your purchases haven’t changed.
live.accessBody: Choose an active live package from your dashboard. Teacher selection becomes available after your payment is confirmed.
live.unavailableBody: Return to the teaching team to see the profiles available for your package.
live.introFallback: Get to know your teacher and explore their available lesson times.
live.getToKnow: A familiar face for your journey
live.yourPaceBody: A space to ask questions, practise, and build confidence. Your lessons are part of your purchased Eduway program.
live.tryAnotherDay: Choose another day to see your teacher’s availability.
live.noGroups: New group sessions are on the way.
live.checkBack: Your teacher’s sessions will appear here when available.
live.selectedTime: Selected lesson time. No reservation has been made.
live.bookingHelp: You can explore availability now. Contact our team to arrange your lessons.
live.checkoutDelivery: After payment confirmation, open your live package to choose a teacher. Lessons take place at their scheduled times.
live.cancelExplanation: Your reservation will be cancelled and its credit returned to this package.
live.bookingConfirmed: Your lesson is booked. You can find it in your dashboard.
live.creditExplanation: Confirming this reservation uses one lesson credit from your package.
live.chooseBeforeBooking: Choose this teacher before reserving a lesson.
live.filesUploaded: File published. Students with access can now open it.
live.recordingUploadHelp: MP4, MOV or WebM, up to 5 GB, uploaded directly to Vimeo. For a group lesson, upload once for all booked students. Keep this page open until the upload finishes.
live.materialUploadHelp: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, images, audio or TXT, up to 50 MB. Only students entitled to these materials can open them.
live.playbackError: Playback failed. Reload the video link, or try an MP4 encoded with H.264/AAC.
live.removeFileConfirm: Remove this file from students’ library? Vimeo originals remain archived in your Vimeo account.
live.materialAdminHelp: Attach materials to the existing live packages. Access follows the package’s materials settings and completed add-on purchases.
live.materialStudentHelp: Your included resources, ready to revisit whenever you study.
live.materialsIncluded: Materials included for all actively enrolled students
live.materialsAddon: Materials available to students who purchased the add-on
live.materialsNotIncluded: This package does not include materials. Change its materials setting in the product editor if needed.
live.noMaterialsYet: Materials have not been published yet.
live.groupRecordingHelp: Shared with students booked into this group. Uploading here adds the recording to each student’s past lessons.
live.recordingNeeded: This lesson needs its recording. Upload the video when it is ready.
live.recordingNotAvailable: No recording is currently available. Your teacher may still be preparing it, or its access period has ended.
live.vimeoUploaded: Uploaded to Vimeo. The recording will appear after processing.
live.vimeoFailed: Vimeo could not prepare this recording. Remove it and upload again, or contact your administrator.
live.vimeoNotConfigured: Vimeo is not connected yet. An administrator needs to finish the connection before videos can be uploaded.
